live:
Map nights are open to visitors, and your first one is free.

What we do

Map night

Members and visitors. We spread a sheet across the tables and read it together, from the contour lines to the place names. Second Tuesday of each month, 7 p.m.

Field days

Members of every age. We take a sheet outside with map and compass and find its points on the ground. One Saturday a month, June through August.

Junior program

Ages 10 to 16. Young members learn to read a map and take a bearing, with two adults at every session. Map nights all year, field days in summer.

Where and when

Where

Kittiwake Hall, Spenard, Anchorage.

When

The second Tuesday of each month, at 7 p.m.

Questions

Write to info@turnagain-geographic.example, and a volunteer will answer within a week.
